title: Tarte Tatin
description: A traditional France dish made with apple, puff pastry. This home-style preparation follows its characteristic cooking method and uses measured ingredients.

steps.instruction: Heat the listed ingredients over moderate heat, stirring only as needed, for about 11 minutes until amber and fragrant.
Layer the prepared elements evenly in the baking dish, spreading filling right to the edges.
Roast in a preheated 190°C oven for about 27 minutes until nicely browned and fully cooked; turn once if needed.
Assemble the cooled components with the listed fillings or toppings. Refrigerate briefly if needed to set the layers.
Bake in a preheated 180°C oven for about 30 minutes until set, golden and cooked through. Cool on a rack.
